description: Routine quarterly inspection. Found minor refrigerant leak at service valve. Repaired and recharged.
High head pressure alarm investigated. Cleaned condenser coils. Pressure returned to normal operating range.
Intermittent high head pressure alarms reported by BMS. Cause undetermined. Requires investigation and root cause analysis.
Annual inspection completed. No issues found. All operating pressures within specification.
Filter replacement and belt inspection. All filters replaced. Belt tension adjusted. Unit returned to service.
